title: Downloading Zscaler Client Connector for VDI

blocks.text: In the Zscaler Admin Console, on the VDI App Store page, you can download Zscaler Client Connector for Virtual Desktop Infrastructure (VDI) for Windows. You can download the latest version or one of the older versions still available for download. To learn more about Zscaler Client Connector for VDI, see What Is Zscaler Client Connector for VDI?
To download Zscaler Client Connector for VDI:

blocks.item: In the Zscaler Admin Console, from the navigation menu, go to Infrastructure > Client Connector > App Store for VDI.
On the General Availability tab, view the latest released versions. On the Limited Availability tab, view versions that are not yet fully qualified.
Click the Download icon for the version you want in the MSI URL (64 bit) column.
